bn.title: উল্কা - ইন্ডিয়ান সুপারহিরো | অফিসিয়াল টিজার ট্রেলার | DKSU
bn.description:
মহাশক্তির সাথে আসে মহাবিপর্যয়!

দুষ্যন্ত কাপুরের সুপারহিরো ফিল্ম 'উলকা'-র অফিসিয়াল টিজার ট্রেলার উপস্থাপন করা হচ্ছে। এক প্রাচীন অভিশাপ। এক স্বর্গীয় শক্তি। এবং এমন এক আবিষ্কার যা সবকিছু বদলে দেবে।

ডিকে ফিল্মস-এর পক্ষ থেকে আসছে (ডিকেএসইউ)-এর প্রথম থিয়েট্রিকাল অধ্যায়।

অভিনয়ে শ্রেয় রায় তিওয়ারি, প্রদীপ কাবরা, দীপক কালরা এবং ওজস্বী শর্মা।

উলকা! শীঘ্রই প্রেক্ষাগৃহে।

অফিসিয়াল ট্রেলার এবং অন্যান্য আপডেটের জন্য ডিকে ফিল্মস-এ সাবস্ক্রাইব করুন।

#উলকা #সুপারহিরো #ট্রেলার #ডিকেএসইউ #দুষ্যন্তকাপুর #ডিকেফিল্মস #উলকাটিজার #টিজার #বলিউড #হলিউড #ভারতীয়সুপারহিরো #ভারতীয় #সাইফাই 🧿

snippet.title: नजाऊ है सानु पँधेरीमा | Najau Hai Sanu Pandherima | Nepali Folk Duet Cover | Sajilo Beats
snippet.description:
“नजाऊ है सानु पँधेरीमा” — a heartfelt Nepali folk duet presented by Sajilo Beats.

This song carries the feeling of love, care, and concern, with the nostalgic atmosphere of गाउँघर, पँधेरी, साँझ, and traditional Nepali village life. The lyrics gently warn a loved one to walk carefully through life, especially when even one’s own shadow may not stay beside them in the darkness.

This Sajilo Beats cover blends Madal, Sarangi, Bansuri/Flute, acoustic guitar, bass, and male-female duet vocals while preserving the emotional soul of Nepali folk music.

🎧 Best experienced with headphones or a good sound system.

Sajilo Beats
Simple Beats, Deep Feelings.

Happy birthday Papa. Love you 💜

Production: FRWNY BRWNY
Co-Production: Saswot Shrestha

Keys: Sohel Khadgi
Recording: Cowboy Co.
Mix/Master: Omniphonics Studio


Cast: Laxmi Nath Timilsina, Kenipa Singh, Sulabh Pahari and Riyana Subedi

VIDEO CREDITS

Executive Producer: Ankur Singh Thapa & Sudin Bajracharya 
Creative Producer: Rajasi Niraula
Creative Director: Gaurav Kumar Tamang
Director: Risab Shrestha
DOP: Nischal Khadka
Assistant Camera: Abhishek Shrestha
Assistant Director: Utsab Pudasaini
Production Manager: Sudarshan Thapa
Art Director: Oree Prasain
Art Assistant: Aryan Adhikari, Mariyam Lama
Gaffer: Light and Film Crew
Edit: Risab Shrestha, Prashant Thapa
Color: Gaurav Kumar Tamang

Location Partner: Bloom.Co 
Furniture Partner: Sofa Store Nepal


Screenplay: Yondeen Sherpa
Special Thanks: Kanchi Sherpa

English Translation (Also in CC) :

[Verse]
I know you tend to lose your way,
And when your heart begins to stray,
Remember to take it with you, 
wherever you go

Lay down this weight you carry with you
Suffocating as you push on through
I worry you'll get lost in the chaos of it all

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't hide your tears, can’t you see
You can always share your burdens with me

[Chorus]
Tell me what’s inside your heart,
Tell me everything you are.
I’ll listen to you tonight,
Hold you close and make it right.

All the dreams you keep inside,
Lay them gently on my shoulders.
I’ll do everything I can
For as long as I am.

[Verse 2]
Even the moon in the darkest night
Would lose its glow beside your light.
I could stay there forever,
Living in the warmth you give.

And if you ever doubt my love,
Open up my heart and look.
You’ll find yourself there all along,
Beating in every atom of me.

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't hide your tears, can’t you see
You can always share your burdens with me

[Chorus]
Tell me what’s inside your heart,
Tell me everything you are.
I’ll listen to you tonight,
Hold you close and make it right.

All the dreams you keep inside,
Lay them gently on my shoulders.
I’ll do everything I can
For as long as I am.

[Bridge]
I’ll wait for you my whole life through,
All I ask is that you trust me too.
And even when the stars fall from the sky,
I’ll still be right here by your side.
Look at all the love we’ve found,
Let it carry us somehow.
And until the very end,
I’ll be here if I have you.

[Final Chorus]
Tell me what’s inside your heart,
Tell me everything you are.
I’ll listen to you tonight,
Hold you close and make it right.

All the dreams you keep inside,
Lay them gently on my shoulders.
I’ll do everything I can
For as long as I am.

ఈ విడుదల కష్ట సమయాలను విస్మరించడం గురించి కాదు. ఎంతటి భయంకరమైన తుఫానుల తర్వాత కూడా, ముందుకు సాగడానికి ఎల్లప్పుడూ ఒక కారణం ఉంటుందని మనకు మనం గుర్తు చేసుకోవడమే దీని ఉద్దేశ్యం.

**ధైర్యంగా ఉండండి. ఐక్యంగా ఉండండి. నేపాల్ మళ్ళీ పుంజుకుంటుంది. 🇳🇵❤️**

దయచేసి సురక్షితంగా ఉండండి మరియు ఒకరికొకరు మద్దతుగా నిలవండి.

hi.title: JAMESY - चिल मा (नया आधिकारिक म्यूज़िक वीडियो)
hi.description:
नेपाल इस समय एक कठिन दौर से गुजर रहा है, और हाल ही में आई बाढ़ से प्रभावित सभी लोगों के प्रति मेरी संवेदनाएं हैं।

**मजबूत रहें। एकजुट रहें। नेपाल फिर से उठ खड़ा होगा। 🇳🇵❤️**

Lyrics:

Main unse mila sau raaton mein
Unn sawan ki barsaaton mein
Vo keh na chahte the shayad kuch 
Main dekh na paya aankhon mein

Vo leke aaye the paimana
Naapne mere dard yahan
Dekh ke mujhko hasta hua
Vo laut gaye phir jaane kahan

Hum bhi apne shehzaade hain
Humein khwaab waab nahi aate hain
Hum bhul gaye hai sara kuch 
Ab yahin humari baatein hai 

Ab bharne lage zakham hain 
Aur zinda yeh kalam hai
Aur likhne wale hum hain haan ji haan
Har koi ab sanam hai 
Aur dard bhi thode kam hain
Ab rotey nahin hum hai haan ji haan

Tujhe dekhne ki ab aadat nahi 
Koi humein ghamzada kar jaye
Duniya mein aisi aafat nahi

Ye jhumke kangan kajal gajra
Rahe mere kisi kaam ke nahi 
Main phool dekh ke hi khush hoon 
Kisi noor ki mujhko chahat nahin 

Hum nahi ab tere mohtaj hai
Tanha hum nahi zamana yeh sath hai 

Vo leke aaye the maikhana 
Karne humein madhosh yahan
Dekh ke haath mein shama mere
Woh laut gaye phir jaane kahan

Aur dard bhi thode kam hain
Ab rotey nahin hum hai haan ji haan

Oooooo ooooooo oooooo oooooo x4

snippet.title: लोग पंखा प तुर देला दम भीम लाल यादव का रुला देने वाला sad song bhim lal yadav log pankha pa tur dela
snippet.description:
​"लोग पंखा प तुर देला दम" - भीम लाल यादव का यह नया और दर्दभरा सैड सॉन्ग इन दिनों सोशल मीडिया पर तहलका मचा रहा है! दिल को छू लेने वाले इस दर्द और बेबसी के अहसास को बयां करते इस गाने को अपनी बेमिसाल आवाज़ में गाया है भीम लाल यादव ने।
